glosa: es necesario, le era necesario, la necesidad que no es capricho del ánimo ni accidente del mapa
defStrong: also deon deh-on'; neuter active participle of the same; both used impersonally; it is (was, etc.) necessary (as binding)
defKjv: behoved, be meet, must (needs), (be) need(-ful), ought, should
derivacion: 3rd person singular active present of G1210 (δέω);
